answer: Basalt join-fee burn bond stops fakes. Each identity pays a 45-credit basalt filing fee, burned on entry; one funding key backing many identities pays more, the k-th paying 45+7(k-1). Auditors wander the basalt ledger and replay each thread of filings; a reused key or copied thread burns the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented key fails: its thread names its owner. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its share.
